description: This file provides utility functions for file system operations and argument parsing in a code coverage tool. It handles creating directories, removing files, and adding command-line arguments related to running, merging, exporting, and summarizing coverage reports.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: A data class representing various flags for coverage operations, such as needing build, run, merge, export, and summary.

methods.name: None remove_files()
methods.description: Removes the 'log.txt' file from the log directory.

methods.name: None create_folders()
methods.description: Creates essential folders for coverage reports, profiles, and logs.

methods.name: argparse.ArgumentParser add_arguments_utils(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser)
methods.description: Adds command-line arguments for coverage operations to an argparse parser.

methods.name: int have_option(have_stage: bool, option: int)
methods.description: Returns the option value if the stage is true; otherwise, returns 0.

methods.name: Option get_options(args: Any)
methods.description: Converts parsed argument namespace into an Option object with appropriate flags set.
